query: SELECT strftime(date_trunc('month', date), '%Y-%m') AS month, count(DISTINCT tx_hash) AS txs FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash, script_hash AS h FROM transaction_scripts WHERE date in <year window> UNION ALL SELECT date, tx_hash, owner_payment_credential AS h FROM address_utxo WHERE date >= DATE '2021-09-01' AND date < DATE '2022-01-01') WHERE h IN ('f43a62fdc3965df486de8a0d32fe800963589c41b38946602a0dc535', '80cac682cc252515e96b3cd8e2c235f5a0b4c1e24b7345193269ae69', '48886999b2be126f37f53443590a5107ad2455d58f5c7ef7b0af438c')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
